journey.name: Jade Passphrase Wallet
journey.description: Pairs the wallet a BIP39 passphrase typed on the Jade emulator opens, next to the Jade's own wallet. Requires `JADE_MODE=interactive JADE_PASSPHRASE=always ./scripts/jade-emulator start` in `bitkit-docker`, a regtest debug build with the Jade emulator enabled (see the README) and the Jade's own wallet already paired from an earlier start without `JADE_PASSPHRASE` (the seed stays the same across starts). The device asks for a passphrase after every PIN; `./scripts/jade-emulator passphrase` types one on its keyboard and confirms it.

actions.action: Launch the Bitkit app, open the menu (testTag "HeaderMenu"), tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), tap "Hardware Wallets" (testTag "HardwareWalletsSettings") and tap "Add Hardware Wallet" (testTag "AddHardwareWallet")
Tap "Continue" (testTag "HardwareWalletIntroContinue"), then "Connect" (testTag "HardwareWalletFoundConnect") on the "Found Jade" step

Run `./scripts/jade-emulator pin 012345`, then `./scripts/jade-emulator passphrase test` in `bitkit-docker`, and verify the "Device Connected" step (testTag "HardwareWalletPairedScreen") headed "Paired Jade" appears within 30 seconds with a balance of 0
Tap "Finish" (testTag "HardwareWalletPairedFinish"), open Settings → "Hardware Wallets" again and verify two Jade wallets are listed: the one paired before, with its balance, and the new one at 0
